newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Electric to boost HD output capacity in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Electric to boost HD output capacity in Japan.

text.p: Fuji Electric Co Ltd said on Monday it would invest about 17 billion yen to boost capacity for production of magnetic hard disks (HDs) at its Matsumoto plant in central Japan by 18 million disks a year.
The extended part of the plant will start operations in January 1998, the company said in a statement.

Together with its current domestic production capacity and capacity at a plant in Malaysia now under construction, Fuji Electric expects its total HD output capacity in 1998 to reach 118 million disks a year.
Currently, it is capable of producing 50 million HDs at its plants at Matsumoto and Yamanashi, also in central Japan.
Domestic production capacity will be raised to 68 million HDs a year after the Matsumoto plant is extended, it said.
Its Malaysian plant, in Kulim Hi-Tec Park in Kedah state, is expected to start shipments in April 1998. It will have production capacity of 50 million HDs a year, it said.
Fuji Electric said the investment in the Malaysian plant will be about 60 billion yen.
